title: Kernel presentation of a tensor product by additive relations
statement: Let D be a commutative ring and let M and P be D-modules with additive commutative group structures. Write G = FreeAbelianGroup(M × P) and [u,z] for its pair generator. Let T consist of all [0,z], [u,0], [u+v,z]−[u,z]−[v,z], [u,z+w]−[u,z]−[u,w], and [d•u,z]−[u,d•z], with u,v in M, z,w in P, and d in D. Let E:G→M⊗_D P be the additive homomorphism sending [u,z] to u⊗_D z. Then ker E is the additive subgroup generated by T.
lean_statement: ∀ {D : Type*} [CommRing D] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module D M] {P : Type*} [AddCommGroup P] [Module D P], let b : M → P → FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) := fun u z => FreeAbelianGroup.of (u, z); (FreeAbelianGroup.lift (fun x : M × P => TensorProduct.tmul D x.1 x.2)).ker = AddSubgroup.closure {r : FreeAbelianGroup (M × P) | (∃ z : P, r = b 0 z) ∨ (∃ u : M, r = b u 0) ∨ (∃ (u v : M) (z : P), r = b (u + v) z - b u z - b v z) ∨ (∃ (u : M) (z w : P), r = b u (z + w) - b u z - b u w) ∨ (∃ (d : D) (u : M) (z : P), r = b (d • u) z - b u (d • z))}
